4.text: I was told that thousands of people had already gathered in the plaza near the House, in anticipation of today's spectacle.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: I was told that despite our not announcing the reforms publicly, hundreds of people had gathered in the plaza near the House, expecting our arrival.

9.speaker: Narrator

17.speaker: Narrator
17.text: The sidewalks were slowly coming to life, with street vendors preparing to showcase their wares, and large groups of people walking towards the parliament with Rizian flags in their hands.

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: Titus, seated next to the driver, received a radio message. After listening to it, he turned his head towards me and pulled down the screen between us.

19.speaker: Titus Gordion
19.text: "Yes. That's what we were told, Your Majesty."

21.speaker: Titus Gordion
21.text: "Your Majesty. Due to a massive gathering just outside the parliament, we're being redirected towards the second entrance of the House of Delegates."
21.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_NatDes_Happened"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_Public"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == false

22.speaker: Titus Gordion
22.text: "Your Majesty. We've just received word from the security. The entrance to the House of Delegates is clear."
22.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_NatDes_Happened"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_Public"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == false) == false

23.speaker: Titus Gordion
23.text: "We'll be proceeding to enter the complex from the Silver Gate within a couple minutes."

28.speaker: Titus Gordion
28.text: "Everything will be fine. I know you've been planning for this day for a long time."

30.speaker: Narrator
30.text: The parliament building came into view, its plain facade adorned with flags and symbols of the nation's heritage, shining in the middle of the empty streets.
30.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_NatDes_Happened"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_Public"] == true) == false

31.text: "Not at all, Your Majesty. Everything is under control."

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.text: "Didn't you say there was a massive gathering?"

57.speaker: Player_Romus
57.text: "There is nobody around the House of Delegates. Why are we being directed to the Silver Gate again?"

58.speaker: Narrator
58.text: From the car window, I could just see the Golden Gate, the main entrance of the parliamentary complex. However, there was no crowd waiting for us there.

60.speaker: Titus Gordion
60.text: "We were told to approach from the southern side of the building for security reasons, Your Majesty."

61.speaker: Titus Gordion
61.text: "We'll be proceeding to enter the complex from the Golden Gate within a couple minutes."

62.speaker: Narrator
62.text: Instead of going forward to the main entrance, the convoy took a turn before reaching the parliament.

63.speaker: Narrator
63.text: The side street we were in was already cleared of any bystanders. There was nobody on the street apart from a few policemen.

64.speaker: Narrator
64.text: As we reached the end of the street, the convoy stopped. I noticed Titus and the driver were receiving messages from their earpieces.

65.speaker: Titus Gordion
65.text: "Your Majesty. We are on hold until the police clear the way to the Silver Gate."

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "Thanks for telling me, Titus. Is there something to be worried about?"

70.speaker: Titus Gordion
70.text: "The police said they have to make sure there is no security risk for our convoy before letting us through."

71.speaker: Narrator
71.text: After a few minutes passed, Titus made a signal and called out to the police officer, who was standing in front of the convoy.

72.speaker: Narrator
72.text: She came to us with quick steps. Titus lowered the window on his side of the car to speak with her.

73.speaker: Titus Gordion
73.text: "What's taking so long? The King needs to join a session at the House of Delegates."

74.speaker: Narrator
74.text: The officer leaned in: "Sir. The entrance hasn't been cleared yet."

75.speaker: Narrator
75.text: "We are waiting for additional forces to arrive before commencing the clearance."

77.speaker: Narrator
77.text: "No, sir. We just need a few more minutes."

78.speaker: Narrator
78.text: I checked my pocket watch. We were already late for the signing.

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "Titus. Tell the police to let us through. I don't care about the security risks. This is the King's order."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "Titus. Tell the convoy that we're going back to the palace."

83.speaker: Narrator
83.text: He nodded and turned back to the officer.

84.speaker: Titus Gordion
84.text: "Your Majesty. I don't know how we can turn the entire convoy around in this small street."

85.speaker: Narrator
85.text: He gestured at the Golden Guard's cars behind us.

86.speaker: Narrator
86.text: The officer shook her head regretfully.

87.speaker: Narrator
87.text: Suddenly, I noticed a group of armored vehicles passing by the street we weren't allowed on, driving in the direction of the House of Delegates.

88.speaker: Narrator
88.text: The officer continued to assure us that it would take a few minutes at most before they could allow us to proceed.

89.speaker: Narrator
89.text: After noticing the armored cars ahead, Titus talked to his radio and asked for a situation report.

135.speaker: Titus Gordion
135.text: "They must have been organizing since you announced the date of the constitutional reforms. I don't know how we didn't receive any intelligence of this before."

136.speaker: Titus Gordion
136.text: "Your rivals and key security personnel were already being watched. I don't know how we didn't receive any intelligence of this beforehand."

137.speaker: Titus Gordion
137.text: "Somebody on the inside must have shared the details of what's happening today. I don't know how we didn't receive any intelligence of this beforehand."

138.speaker: Titus Gordion
138.text: "This cannot be a coincidence. But the police are trying to assure us everything is under control."

139.speaker: Player_Romus
139.text: "I should have known Rico would be behind something like this. I'll make him pay."

140.speaker: Player_Romus
140.text: "Titus. I don't think we can trust any intelligence right now. Please take us to safety."

144.speaker: Player_Romus
144.text: "Just tell the convoy to keep driving. I don't want to be pinned down on this small street."

145.speaker: Player_Romus
145.text: "I want you to be on high alert, Titus. I don't trust the police."

147.speaker: Player_Romus
147.text: "And what are those armored vehicles doing inside the city?"

148.speaker: Titus Gordion
148.text: "They must be part of the police forces, sir. No military is allowed here."

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "We will listen to the officer and wait here."

151.speaker: Narrator
151.text: Titus nodded and immediately sent a radio message to the whole convoy.

153.speaker: Narrator
153.text: As soon as our drivers ignited the engines, the leading officers from the blockade came running, surrounding our cars.

154.speaker: Narrator
154.text: They shouted at me that they couldn't let me leave. There was a security risk.

155.speaker: Titus Gordion
155.text: "Move away from the vehicles or we will run you over."

156.speaker: Narrator
156.text: The officers hesitated, retreating slightly. Murmurs crackled through their radios as they conferred swiftly amongst themselves.

157.speaker: Narrator
157.text: Suddenly, they pointed their guns directly at us.

160.speaker: Narrator
160.text: As our convoy inched forward, the officers paced alongside with their shouts of "halt", still maintaining a tight perimeter around us.

162.speaker: Narrator
162.text: Hearing my screams, the guards readied their weapons and started shooting. From my vantage point inside the vehicle, I could see the officers diving for cover.

163.speaker: Narrator
163.text: And then, hell broke loose with gunshots erupting from each side.

164.speaker: Narrator
164.text: For a split second, the driver's eyes met mine in the rearview mirror as he nodded and slammed his foot on the gas pedal.

165.speaker: Narrator
165.text: As we lurched forward, the officers scrambled, trying to evade our vehicle.

166.speaker: Narrator
166.text: Within a few seconds, the officers' widening eyes and their screams were swallowed by the roar of the engine.

167.speaker: Narrator
167.text: After a minute or two, the same armored vehicles we saw before began heading towards us from the direction of the parliament.

168.speaker: Narrator
168.text: As I tried to understand what was going on, a military officer leapt atop one of the vehicles, grabbed a megaphone and made an announcement.

180.speaker: Narrator
180.text: "Abdicate the throne to Hugo Toras, and your life and noble status will be spared."
180.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Reform_Coup_Toras"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == false)

181.speaker: Narrator
181.text: "Abdicate the throne to Ricardus Toras, and your life and noble status will be spared."
181.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Reform_Coup_Toras"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false)

187.speaker: Narrator
187.text: "You are under arrest for conspiring against the Rizian monarchy and the very title you hold."

188.speaker: Narrator
188.text: "For attempting to dismantle the Rizian monarchy, traitor Manus Sazon and the members of the Rizian People's Party have been arrested."

189.speaker: Narrator
189.text: As his words echoed, I felt fear creep up in me.

193.speaker: Player_Romus
193.text: "I need to do as they say."

194.speaker: Player_Romus
194.text: "There is nothing we can do, Titus. I have to comply."

196.speaker: Narrator
196.text: Hearing my screams, the driver slammed his foot on the brake pedal.

197.speaker: Narrator
197.text: Within a few seconds, the officers quickly surrounded our vehicle and took us outside.

200.speaker: Narrator
200.text: They pinned us down and with a clink of metal handcuffs, they secured our wrists.

201.speaker: Player_Romus
201.text: "What the hell are you doing? I am your King!"

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "You must have mistaken me for someone else."

207.speaker: Player_Romus
207.text: "We are not resisting. This is not necessary."

208.speaker: Player_Romus
208.text: "I am not resisting. This is not necessary."

209.speaker: Player_Romus
209.text: "I am not a common criminal. Take these off of me!"

210.speaker: Player_Romus
210.text: "Whatever you do, please don't hurt my family."

211.speaker: Player_Romus
211.text: "One day, you will pay for this."

212.speaker: Narrator
212.text: They did not react to what I said. They simply smiled as they disarmed my guards.

215.speaker: Narrator
215.text: They quickly pinned me down and, with the clink of metal handcuffs, secured my wrists.

216.speaker: Narrator
216.text: They did not react. They quickly disarmed the rest of my guards. The officer spoke to me.

217.speaker: Narrator
217.text: "For attempting to dismantle the Rizian monarchy, Manus Sazon and the traitors of the Rizian People's Party have been arrested."

218.speaker: Narrator
218.text: "And you, Romus Toras, are under arrest for conspiring against the Rizian monarchy and the very title you hold."

221.speaker: Player_Romus
221.text: "One day, you will pay for this."

223.speaker: Narrator
223.text: They grabbed me by my arms and shoved me into a police truck.

224.speaker: Narrator
224.text: I had no idea where they were taking me.

246.speaker: Narrator
246.text: Within just a second, hell broke loose around me with gunshots erupting from each side. I threw myself on the floor of the vehicle.

247.speaker: Narrator
247.text: Hearing my screams, the guards readied their weapons and started shooting. From my vantage point inside the vehicle, I could see the officers diving for cover.

248.speaker: Narrator
248.text: Before any of us could react, there was a deafening explosion.

249.speaker: Narrator
249.text: The engine of our vehicle roared as the driver hit the gas pedal. We quickly drove among the sounds of Kalsingtons being fired from every direction.

250.speaker: Narrator
250.text: The world outside became a blur of motion and noise. Bullets pinged against the armored exterior of the vehicle as we drove down the street.

251.speaker: Titus Gordion
251.text: "We can't go back to the palace now. Take us to the emergency bunker!"

252.speaker: Narrator
252.text: The streets became a labyrinthine escape route, as we navigated through them with great speed.

253.speaker: Narrator
253.text: In the aftermath of our escape, as we put distance between ourselves and the rebels, I let out a deep sigh.

254.speaker: Narrator
254.text: I had survived this attack. But my usurper was still out there.

351.speaker: Narrator
351.text: It was early in the morning. We were driving in a sleek, black car adorned with the royal crest, towards the House of Delegates.

352.speaker: Narrator
352.text: Titus was seated up front next to the driver. His eyes, reflected in the rearview mirror, had a steely coldness to them.

356.speaker: Player_Romus
356.text: "I'm sorry I didn't let you in on my plans. But it was for your own safety."

357.speaker: Player_Romus
357.text: "You had better not sabotage these reforms, Captain Gordion. You've seen what happens to people who get in my way."

362.speaker: Player_Romus
362.text: "You should know I'm dissolving the Royal Council. But I hope I can still trust you with my personal security."

363.speaker: Narrator
363.text: His face assumed a concentrated look as received a radio message. After listening to it, he turned his head towards me and pulled down the screen between us.

365.speaker: Titus Gordion
365.text: "I swore an oath to protect the Rizian Crown, and I will do so for as long as it exists. No matter the changes to its role."

366.speaker: Titus Gordion
366.text: "I stand ready to support your aims, sir."

367.speaker: Titus Gordion
367.text: "You did what you felt was necessary, sir. I hold no grudges."

374.speaker: Narrator
374.text: Curiously, two of them bore the logo of Palantor Security Solutions.

378.speaker: Titus Gordion
378.text: "Russello Montoro is undoubtedly mixed up in this somehow. I never liked him."

390.speaker: Narrator
390.text: After a few minutes passed, I started getting restless.

394.speaker: Titus Gordion
394.text: "I think we should listen to the police, Your Majesty."

395.speaker: Titus Gordion
395.text: "Just give it a couple more minutes."

396.speaker: Player_Romus
396.text: "I said take me out of here! NOW!"

397.speaker: Player_Romus
397.text: "No, Titus. I just gave you an order."

400.speaker: Narrator
400.text: At that moment, the same armored vehicles we saw before began heading towards us from the direction of the parliament.

404.speaker: Titus Gordion
404.text: "I'm afraid there's nothing more you can do, sir."

407.speaker: Titus Gordion
407.text: "Please step out of the vehicle and surrender to the authorities."

409.speaker: Player_Romus
409.text: "Don't tell me you are part of this, Titus..."

410.speaker: Player_Romus
410.text: "I thought you had sworn an oath to protect the Crown at all costs."

412.speaker: Titus Gordion
412.text: "I'm afraid there is no way out of this, sir. We are completely surrounded."

413.speaker: Narrator
413.text: He looked at me -- his eyes cold and vacant.

414.speaker: Narrator
414.text: The expected gunshots didn't arrive. Titus turned to looked at me -- his eyes cold and vacant.

415.speaker: Narrator
415.text: Titus didn't move. He turned to looked at me -- his eyes cold and vacant.

416.speaker: Player_Romus
416.text: "Titus. I just gave you an order."

417.speaker: Player_Romus
417.text: "Then what the hell do we do!?"

419.speaker: Titus Gordion
419.text: "I'm afraid there's nothing more we can do, sir."

420.speaker: Titus Gordion
420.text: "I'm afraid there's nothing more I can do, sir."

421.speaker: Titus Gordion
421.text: "I'm sorry, Your Majesty... but this has been decided beyond me."

422.speaker: Titus Gordion
422.text: "And I have. From within and from without."

423.speaker: Titus Gordion
423.text: "The Crown is more than the man who wears it."

424.speaker: Titus Gordion
424.text: "Please, sir. There is no need to delay the inevitable."

426.speaker: Titus Gordion
426.text: "Let's not make it any harder than it already is. Please just step outside, sir."

427.speaker: Player_Romus
427.text: "And if I don't? Are you going to drag me out like some petty criminal?"

429.speaker: Player_Romus
429.text: "What the hell, Titus? I entrusted you with my life."

431.speaker: Titus Gordion
431.text: "I never wanted this, but my duty isn't to one man -- it's to the monarchy."

432.speaker: Titus Gordion
432.text: "I'll do what I must. But I hope it won't come to that."

435.speaker: Player_Romus
435.text: "You're doing what you think is right. I hope you can live with it."

436.speaker: Player_Romus
436.text: "You better pray they don't remember this betrayal, Titus."

437.speaker: Titus Gordion
437.text: "They will remember, sir. But as you being the one who betrayed the monarchy and turned against the very Crown you wore."

438.speaker: Titus Gordion
438.text: "We all carry something, sir. Some of us longer than others."

440.speaker: Titus Gordion
440.text: "But the moment you turned against the throne, the path was set."

443.speaker: Player_Romus
443.text: "You bastard! You drove me straight into enemy hands!"

447.speaker: Titus Gordion
447.text: "Your Majesty. The officer confirmed that the police is about to clear the way to the Silver Gate."

449.speaker: Titus Gordion
449.text: "We'll just need a moment before we're on our way."

453.speaker: Narrator
453.text: Suddenly, I noticed a group of armored cars passing by the street we weren't allowed on, driving in the direction of the House of Delegates.

454.speaker: Narrator
454.text: The officer continued to assure us that it would take a few minutes at most before they could allow us to proceed.

455.speaker: Player_Romus
455.text: "Rico could be behind something. Let's be careful about the police."

456.speaker: Player_Romus
456.text: "Titus. I don't think we can trust any intelligence right now. Please take us to safety."

460.speaker: Player_Romus
460.text: "Just tell the convoy to keep driving. I don't want to be pinned down on this small street."

461.speaker: Player_Romus
461.text: "I want you to be on high alert, Titus. I don't trust the police."

463.speaker: Player_Romus
463.text: "Titus, what are those armored vehicles doing inside the city?"

464.speaker: Titus Gordion
464.text: "They must be part of the police forces, sir. No military is allowed here."

465.speaker: Player_Romus
465.text: "We will listen to the officer and wait here."

467.speaker: Narrator
467.text: Just as our drivers ignited the engines, the leading officers removed the blockade and told us the road was now safe and clear.

468.speaker: Narrator
468.text: Titus nodded and immediately sent a radio message to the whole convoy.

470.speaker: Player_Romus
470.text: "Never mind. Maybe I was too paranoid."

471.speaker: Player_Romus
471.text: "Just take us to the House of Delegates, Titus. But be on high alert."

472.speaker: Player_Romus
472.text: "Thank God... Well, scratch that and follow the road."

475.speaker: Narrator
475.text: Just then, the leading officers removed the blockade and told us the road was now safe and clear.

476.speaker: Narrator
476.text: We entered the avenue and drove through the Silver Gate. Outside of the security cordon, thousands were waiting for us, holding Rizian flags and the banners of the reform movement.
